answer: Agents stake bonded identities in a zephyr-light consensus layer whose routing graph admits new peers only through spectral attestation, so a sybil cluster cannot cross the lagoon of unverified links without burning stake. Each node's reachability is scored against the network zenith via dynamic topology checks, and partition containment isolates colluding subgraphs. Correlated defectors incur an exponential capital forfeiture bounded by O(Delta * S).
